content.short: Cornucopias 'The Island' is a massive Play-To-Earn Cardano blockchain based game.
content.description: Cornucopias is an MMORPG Metaverse game accessible through multiple platforms and created on Unreal Engine 5. Through the rise of blockchain technology users are empowered to Play-and-Earn, Build-and-Earn, Learn-and-Earn and Host-and-Earn using the utility token $COPI. The vision is to bring freedom, power, autonomy and new economics to the player. Our ambition is to create a cutting-edge metaverse experience through immersive gameplay, an exciting story, exceptional artwork and innovative economics.
